scope: Existing INT8 whole-row streams; normal reads; virtual physical addresses only.
invariants: Each stream retains its chip, exact contiguous logical rows, columns, page count and wave count. The expert-first/FFD policies also retain the block-command count. Row-safe fill instead pays additional per-block commands, 250ns each, and conservatively reloads the full input subvector over ONFI per additional native run. No extra PCIe input or output bytes; the original complete rows are concatenated.
global_expert_first_scope: A single matrix posting order; software allocation only. The paper does not guarantee a particular free-block policy or short-stream cohabitation, so public aif_post alone cannot guarantee these physical addresses.
per_chip_ffd_scope: A controller/FTL free-space allocation policy. Uses existing block/offset/page-count chip operands; no chip PE/ISA addition. Not exposed by the published host API, and its unequal chosen row ownership already requires controller layout support beyond the paper's equal-row aif_post.
row_safe_wave_fill_scope: Mixtral only: keep each down stream whole and fill the remaining wave slots with GU runs, 16 complete output rows per wave. All extra runs return distinct complete rows; host/controller only concatenate. No partial-dot sum, extra row padding, resident accumulator or new chip ISA. Uses the existing per-block GEMV command described in paper footnote 9; requires controller mapping/allocation software to follow the row-run table. No added host command is assumed because the controller handles the runs. Only metadata command overhead is modeled; mapping-table lookup cost is unmeasured.
capacity_scope: IFP LSB reserved stripes; CSB/MSB remain available for general data. Three times this value is covered TLC raw address space, not three times additional occupied model bytes. This inherits the existing planner's I8 payload accounting and excludes GGUF/Q8 scale arrays, FTL tables and other model tensors. Runtime free-space/GC effects are unmodeled.
no_latency_claim: Boundary holes are not read. Reducing reserved holes does not reduce the NAND work bound. Whole-stream packing keeps commands unchanged; compact crossing can only increase modeled control cost.

route_free_overhead_bounds.note: Bounds concern the current additive service model, not hardware or end-to-end inference. Uniform top-2 is a synthetic expectation, not an empirical model route distribution. Host activation is excluded.
